model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: 2027 GV60 Features & Specifications, Exterior Dimensions, 'All Models'. Text extraction offsets values one row from labels (sources/genesis-2027-gv60-features-specs.txt); reading confirmed by C/D.

width_in.note: 'Overall Width', All Models; mirrors not stated. C/D lists the same figure as width without mirrors.

awd.label: 19" AWD, Prestige
awd.note: 2027 GV60 (Carryover) change table and trim list. The Performance AWD trim moved to the separate GV60 Magma for 2027 (not in this universe).

charge_port.note: 2026 GV60 press kit: 'equipped with a native North American Charging Standard (NACS) port'. 2027 is listed as a carryover. The 2027 spec sheet has a 'Charge Port' row whose value isn't in the PDF text layer.

supercharger_access.note: 2026 GV60 press kit: 'equipped with a native North American Charging Standard (NACS) port'. 2027 is listed as a carryover. The 2027 spec sheet has a 'Charge Port' row whose value isn't in the PDF text layer.

cross_check.note: Tesla lists Genesis among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'For new vehicles that are NACS-equipped, no adapter will be necessary.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: 2027 GV60 model page published Jul 30, 2026 with 2027 trim pricing. 2026 GV60 page published Feb 6, 2026. No explicit on-sale date found; treated as on sale (continuing model, 2026 ranked by C/D and Edmunds).

epa_range.note: Excludes the 2027 GV60 Magma (EPA 50637, 222 mi), which is a separate model outside this universe (see awd.note).

trims.note: 2027 GV60 trim changes: 'RWD, 19" AWD, Prestige AWD, Magma*'. The Magma is a separate model outside this universe.

entries.note: C/D test sheet 'Peak Charge Rate, AC/DC: 10.9/350 kW' for a GV60 Performance. 350 kW matches Genesis's charger-class wording ('Ultra-Fast Charger (up to 800V / 350 kW)'), so it may describe charger compatibility rather than the car's own peak. Genesis publishes no vehicle peak rate in the fetched sources.
'Rapid Charging: >250kW (800V) (from 10% 80% charge) 18 minutes'. charger_kw is the stated floor (>250 kW). 2026 press kit: 'approximately 18 minutes using a 350 kW DC fast charger'.
Not listed in Genesis's 2027 features and specifications or the 2026/2027 press kits.

cargo_cu_ft.note: 'Cargo Volume (Behind 2nd Row) - SAE' 24; '(Behind 1st Row)' 54.7; frunk 0.71. Read from staggered columns (labels and values offset by one row).

height_in.note: 'Overall Height' 62.4 (All Models), read from staggered columns; C/D agrees.

ground_clearance_in.note: Not given in the 2027 features and specifications; C/D lists NA.
